content:
Apple TV has an exciting and packed summer lineup this year, anchored by a variety of compelling series. Here are three fan-favorite returning shows set to be among Apple’s biggest hits of the summer.

#1: Silo season 3

Before Severance and Pluribus became mainstream hits, Silo was perhaps Apple TV’s most well-known sci-fi series.

Silo season 3 debuts Friday, July 3 with one episode, followed by weekly releases through September 4.

With a new split-timeline plot that takes place simultaneously in the past and present, this season will delve deep into the origins of the silos.

You can watch Silo seasons 1-2 here on Apple TV.

#2: Ted Lasso season 4

Following years of speculation and hopes for a new season, Ted Lasso is officially returning soon.

Ted Lasso season 4 arrives Wednesday, August 5 with one episode, then weekly releases through October 7.

Jason Sudeikis’ sports comedy was Apple TV’s first major hit, and remains arguably the streamer’s most beloved series.

Here’s Apple’s season 4 summary, followed by the teaser trailer:

You can watch Ted Lasso seasons 1-3 here on Apple TV.

#3: Dark Matter season 2

Based on one of the most acclaimed sci-fi novels of the last decade, Dark Matter amassed a loyal following after debuting on Apple TV in 2024. Now, it’s about to return.

Dark Matter season 2 premieres Friday, August 28 with one episode, followed by weekly releases through October 30.

The new season isn’t based on any prior works, but the original novel’s author remains the series showrunner and writer. So it’s not a case of a show unnecessarily continuing on past its source material.
